selection_reason.summary: Strong competition: her Wexford win was a bumper, not a hurdle win. Her improved Listowel hurdle second still leaves several comparable opponents. Hey Now can build on his convincing Sligo hurdle win; Le Roi Du Livet is another maiden-hurdle winner; Euro Agent adds recent winning form. Their limitations are return-from-break uncertainty for the first two and a need for more on these terms for Euro Agent.
selection_reason.counterargument: Improving mare from an in-form yard, familiar with the course and receiving 4 lb from Hey Now and 7 lb from Le Roi Du Livet. Those differences offset their official-rating advantages; she could improve past them.

selection_reason.summary: Strong competition: steps from 1m2f to 1m6f on testing ground after racing freely. Stamina is unproven, not a demonstrated defect. Temple can improve for the longer trip, new yard and first cheekpieces; Marquetry can progress from two placed efforts. Temple returns from a break and both principal rivals still need improvement. Salver adds strong staying ability but must translate it from jumping to the Flat.
selection_reason.counterargument: Only two starts, an improving profile and Haggas/Fallon connections. If he settles and stays he could improve substantially. His 5 lb age-related weight advantage over Salver does not by itself decide their relative ability.
